notes.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place, AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We have a very exciting announcement:
We've just released a new horror game to celebrate the Spring Season!

[i]Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place[/i] is available now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485750/Midnight_Scenes_A_Safe_Place/   

Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror.
Welcome to [i]Midnight Scenes[/i].

[list]
[*] Enjoy this exciting and intense tale through the eyes of Phil, a young man tormented by horrible nightmares.
[*] A Horror Fiction Adventure that will take you to unsuspected limits.
[*] Explore, interact with your surroundings...and face your fears.
[*] Colorful pixel art inspired by horror and mystery classics like The Twilight Zone and The Outer Limits.
[*] Spooky and dark original soundtrack.
[*] Atmospheric sound effects.
[/list]

Will you find your safe place?

You can get it 10% off on launch week, so… what are you waiting for? ;)

Octavi & Susanna

notes.title: Our new game Uninvited, available now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We have a very exciting announcement:
We've just released a new horror game for you to enjoy this Spring!

[i]Uninvited [/i]is available now.

You can get it 10% off on launch week, so… what are you waiting for? ;)

Octavi & Susanna

notes.title: Midnight Scenes and The Librarian coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36559274/44d4e652984360b419aaeda21283489c4c605dd4.png[/img]


Hello everyone! After the huge success of my short, free game [i]The Supper[/i], I've decided to release my first three games here on Steam, starting with [i]Midnight Scenes: The Highway[/i], coming early next month.

Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279700/Midnight_Scenes_The_Highway/]wishlist it[/url] so you get notified on release day!

This special edition will include the game with some small visual improvements, an Art Book in PDF and the Original Soundtrack, all for $2.99.

Oh, and the game will come localized to French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese!

[i]Midnight Scenes: The Highway[/i] was the first game I ever made and it has a soft spot in my heart. It's very short and straightforward compared to my later games, but I hope you enjoy the tiny puzzles and creepy atmosphere.

Thank you so much for your continued support! <3
Octavi

notes.title: The Supper - Quick Fix Patch v1.01
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing (or planning to play) The Supper!
I hope you like it :)

Here's a quick patch with some fixes (thanks to Nor Treblig for the bug report):

- Fixed an issue with the camera going out of bounds when the player is on the Pirate Ship.
- Chairs in the dining room are now correctly displayed in front of the player.
- Fixed an issue with the starred background abruptly ending, in the scene with Captain McMurray.
- Fixed an issue where Main Menu wasn't working correctly from the start of the game.
